418 **ROYAL CHEMISTRY**

<margin>
...Astral, Poisonous, and Spiritual, and into a fifth, namely the Scourge <note>original: "Flagellum"</note>.

These Sidereal and Firmamental infections are known by the Adept physician, and they are cured Firmamentally: for Adept medicine is the Art which gives the knowledge of recognizing and expelling Firmamental infections.

The Magnet of Man. Magic Cure, in which there is a celestial impression; after contact with the plant, the plant, as long as it remains putrefied, attracts the medicine into the ulcer, and thus heals it.
</margin>

plainly, the greatest part of diseases coming from the celestial Influence and from the Astral Impression of the Firmament of the Greater World <note>the Macrocosm or universe</note> does not wish to be cured with mixed remedies—such as through the secrets <term>Arcana</term> <gloss>powerful hidden medicinal essences</gloss> of herbs, minerals, and metals—but the cure should be established through Astronomical influence at least with those things which have an Analogy to the greater and lesser world. In these, there is a true Magnetic power of the Firmament and a Celestial Impression for resisting diseases from the Firmament of the greater and lesser world <note>the human body</note>, as appears in Smartweed <term>Persicaria</term>, Comfrey <term>Solidago</term>, Dragonwort <term>Dracunculus</term>, and Great Comfrey <term>Symphytum</term>.

If a disease or pain is inflicted Supernaturally through incantation or a Magical Impression of the Ascendants, then the efforts of the first three ways of healing are useless. Instead, according to Paracelsus, one must proceed Magically and Supernaturally, and the evil must be repelled in the same way it was inflicted. Otherwise, in the said Simples <note>medicinal plants containing only one constituent</note> there is an Influential attractiveness, and all things cure Magically, Astronomically, and Magnetically by Divine ordination, because the medicine is in them and the Magnet is in Man. For just as the Sun and Stars have the power of attracting moisture from lower things, so Man—by his innate magnetic attractive power like a Magnet drawing the spirit of nourishment in place of Iron—and lower things have that same power of attracting from Superior things, as we see in the time of Plague. <summary>Croll explains that diseases caused by celestial or magical influences must be treated with medicines that possess a corresponding magnetic or astronomical power rather than ordinary herbal or mineral remedies.</summary>
